integrity: Recurrence proof over F3 and reproducible finite checks; no claim of outside or independent certification. Older existence criteria are cited without claiming them as new.
scientific_limitations: Only two-row cyclic prisms and Möbius ladders with n>=3, named vertex colors, fixed vertex labels; no full graph-automorphism quotient or broader graph classification. The 2020 Houston paper and the newer cubic total-domatic preprints were only available in abstracts, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Six-periodic rigidity of neighborhood \(3\)-balanced colorings on prisms and Möbius ladders
